historical_growth.owner_fcf_note: Owner FCF = reported FCF - SBC - interest income: FY2024 156,210-18,546-24,868; FY2025 73,870-15,577-20,449; FY2026 -46,609-14,821-18,806. CAGR undefined on a negative end-point. Reported FCF FY2020-FY2025 averaged 134,032M; owner-basis the same years would be ~30-40bn lower. SBC is NOT growing faster than cash flow (it fell 18.5bn -> 14.8bn); the collapse is capex (27.6bn FY2024 -> 84.3bn FY2025 -> 122.0bn FY2026 -> ~250bn FY2027 run-rate).
historical_growth.growth_rate_source: base-case 10-year revenue CAGR (FY2026-FY2036); equity CAGR (2.5%) is not used because RMB ~250bn of buybacks in FY2022-FY2025 and the FY2026 investment trough depress it
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 5yr CAGR 2.5% diverges >30% from revenue 5yr CAGR 7.4% and EPS 3yr CAGR 17.0%; explained by buybacks and the FY2026 trough, not by a different underlying growth rate.

scenario_narratives.base: Execution risk, not impairment. Alibaba is spending the FY2026-FY2028 cash flow of the marketplace on AI compute (capex ~22% of revenue in FY2027, RMB ~250bn) and on the last leg of the quick-commerce subsidy war, so owner FCF is negative in FY2027-FY2029 and only turns in FY2030. The axes that decide the case: (1) whether AI Cloud and Compute Services keeps compounding at 30-45% with EBITA margin rising from 12% (it did in Q1 FY2027); (2) whether capex intensity actually falls after FY2028 -- the July build assumed a plateau in Y3-4, this one assumes peak absolute spend FY2027-28 and intensity normalising from FY2029; (3) whether Taobao Instant Commerce reaches unit-economics breakeven by end-FY2027 as guided while the SAMR anti-subsidy rules hold; (4) whether AI Labs/Qwen consumer losses (RMB13.9bn in one quarter) are capped rather than open-ended; (5) core CMR stays roughly flat (-7% reported / ~+1% underlying) rather than resuming share loss to PDD and Douyin. The EU DSA fine (EUR550M, booked in Q1 FY2027 G&A) and the DoD 1260H litigation are carried in the discount rate, not the flows.
scenario_narratives.bull: Cloud is now a margin story as well as a growth story: 45% growth with EBITA margin doubling, Apple Intelligence embedding Qwen in the China iPhone base, Qwen3-Max-Thinking keeping Alibaba at the frontier, and the $100bn five-year external cloud+AI target on track. The same absolute capex is spread over faster revenue, so intensity normalises by FY2030; quick commerce turns profitable in FY2027 and e-commerce CMR re-accelerates on AI-driven merchant tools. Mature EBITDA margin 25%, terminal FCF margin ~12%; the 15x FCF cap binds, so the bull does not rely on a terminal multiple the market has not paid.
scenario_narratives.bear: The capex supercycle does not pay: management keeps spending through FY2028 (RMB ~500bn over two years) into a price-competitive China AI market (DeepSeek, ByteDance, Huawei), cloud growth decelerates below 25%, AI Labs keeps burning, and the capex is cut only after the returns disappoint. Quick-commerce breakeven slips as Meituan re-engages; CMR resumes low-single-digit decline. On the regulatory axis the EU judges AliExpress remediation inadequate and levies follow-on DSA penalties, and the DoD designation survives the Northern District of California challenge, keeping US institutions out. Owner FCF stays negative until FY2031 and the business is worth little more than its balance sheet (net cash + investments ~HK$26/share of the ~HK$51 bear value).

valuation_philosophy.summary: FY2026-FY2029 are investment-trough years by choice, not demand decline, but the July 2026 build normalised that trough away by starting from a mid-cycle RMB120bn FCF. The Q1 FY2027 print (capex RMB67.7bn, FCF -44.7bn, buybacks -80%, AI Labs -13.9bn, CMR -7% reported) showed the trough deepening in year 1 rather than recovering, so this build models the capex supercycle explicitly as a component owner-FCF path with negative FCF through FY2029 and the recovery pushed to FY2030, discounted at a single RMB-built 10% WACC that carries a widened regulatory/litigation premium for the EU DSA exposure and the DoD designation. Terminal value is Gordon-bound in base and bear (implied ~6x EV/EBITDA, below the FY2022-25 normal-year 8.1x average), so no multiple expansion is assumed; the strategic investment portfolio (Ant etc.) enters the bridge at half book and NCI is deducted, both for the first time. The buyback cut does not change the flat share count (SBC is expensed in full, so buybacks are value-neutral here) but it removes a price support the market had been leaning on, which is reflected in the weights, not the flows.
key_risks_to_valuation: Capex intensity: every 1pp of FY2027-FY2031 capex/revenue that does not normalise is ~RMB 60-70bn of cumulative owner FCF; the base assumes intensity halves from 22% to 11% by FY2032.
Cloud deceleration below 30% before margin matures would break the base margin path (22% mature EBITDA).
EU DSA follow-on penalties (up to 6% of global turnover) and a DoD 1260H loss are in the discount rate (1.25pp), not the flows; a realised penalty of that size would be a flow event.
Investment-portfolio bridge (HK$13.7/share at 50% of book) depends on Ant Group's realisable value and PRC exit taxes; strike it and the weighted IV falls by that amount.
RMB/HKD: every 1% move in CNYHKD moves every HKD value 1%; fx_rate is dated 2026-10-22 and is not refreshed by refresh_price.py.
Mainland Southbound flows are a 9988.HK-specific demand source that can move the HK price away from the ADS parity line for extended periods; the valuation ignores it.

inputs.buyback_note: FY2026 repurchases RMB7,638M (vs 86,662 FY2025); Q1 FY2027 ~US$162M, down ~80% YoY, to fund AI capex. Buybacks are value-neutral in this model (SBC is expensed and the count held flat), so the cut does not change the flat-count convention; it does mean the flat count is now a modelling convention the company is no longer paying for in cash, which is why SBC is charged in full.

Parity: BABA ADS US$104.41 (NYSE close 2026-10-21) x 7.8461 / 8 = HK$102.40 vs 9988.HK HK$103.70 (HKEX close 2026-10-21, ~12h earlier) -- 1.3% gap, within the close-time offset. The RMB has strengthened again since the July build (1.1597), lifting every HKD value ~1.3% before any driver change.
inputs.balance_sheet_note: FY2026 (31 Mar 2026) balance sheet is the latest filing in the folder; the Q1 FY2027 release (20 Aug 2026) is not extracted. Using it is internally consistent: year 1 of the model is FY2027, so the Q1 FY2027 cash burn (FCF -RMB44.7bn, capex 67.7bn) is inside projected year-1 flows, not double-counted against a later balance sheet. net_debt = total debt 259,996 - [cash 131,530 + unrestricted short-term investments 155,236 + unrestricted other treasury investments 234,058 = 520,824] = -260,828 (net CASH), identical basis to the 2026-07-26 build. The July 2026 dividend (RMB ~33.7bn) was paid after the balance-sheet date and is a distribution of equity value, not a reduction in it.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in the flows' own currency (RMB), single rate across scenarios (risk lives in the flows and weights, charged once). Cost of equity 10.6% = China 10y CGB ~1.8% + beta 1.1 x China ERP 5.5% (7.85%) + 1.5% VIE/Cayman-structure and PRC platform-regulation premium + 0.5% US geopolitical/DoD 1260H overhang + 0.75% EU DSA and litigation premium (WIDENED from the prior 0.5% securities-litigation component to cover the EUR550M AliExpress fine, the lapsed 20 Oct 2026 remediation deadline and the open-ended up-to-6%-of-turnover exposure). Debt ~13% of capital at ~2.1% after tax gives 9.5%; rounded UP to 10.0% because the marginal 9988.HK holder (Southbound and international funds) prices off a higher risk-free than onshore CGB. The prior 11.5%/10.5%/13.0% stack was built on a 4.5% USD risk-free and so overstated an RMB rate by ~2.5pp; the bridge attributes this separately.
inputs.lease_treatment: Operating leases are expensed inside adjusted EBITDA (US GAAP ASC 842 operating-lease cost in opex); lease liabilities are therefore EXCLUDED from net debt. Finance leases are immaterial. One treatment, consistently applied.
inputs.nci_treatment: Flows are consolidated; noncontrolling interests (RMB57,539M) and mezzanine equity (RMB7,845M) at 31 Mar 2026 book are deducted once in the equity bridge. Not folded into the tax rate as well.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF component DCF (operating company: marketplace + cloud), 10-year horizon FY2027-FY2036 because the owner-FCF margin is still ramping through FY2031. This supersedes the hand-built 'trough-FCF mid-cycle normalisation with EV/EBITDA exit cap' of 2026-07-26, which started from a normalised RMB120bn FCF base and grew it 22/18/14/10/7%; the component build instead carries the capex supercycle explicitly (FY2027 capex ~22% of revenue, peaking in absolute RMB in FY2027-28, intensity normalising only from FY2029) and therefore yields NEGATIVE owner FCF in FY2027-FY2029 base. Matching-asset rule: interest income and investment income/share of Ant results are outside the flows, so cash-like assets sit in net_debt and the strategic investment portfolio sits in equity_bridge (at 50% of book). Charge-once rules: SBC expensed + flat count; NCI deducted in the bridge only; leases in opex only; single WACC. Terminal value = max(0, min(Gordon, cap x FCF_N)) on FCF: Gordon binds in base (14.7x FCF); the FCF cap binds in bull (15x vs Gordon 15.9x) and marginally in bear (12x vs Gordon 12.75x). Implied terminal EV/EBITDA ~6x base, below the corrected FY2022-25 normal-year range 4.6x-9.9x (avg 8.1x), so no re-rating is assumed. All RMB-level assumptions are listing-venue-agnostic and should be mirrored into BABA_DCF.json at its next refresh (BABA is still on the 2026-07-26 build).

bear.rationale: AI capex ROI disappoints: FY2027-28 spend proceeds as committed (23%/21% of revenue) but is then cut hard because it does not earn its return, so capex reverts to the 8% pre-AI-plus-cloud norm by FY2034 while revenue growth never exceeds 6% and the EBITDA margin recovers only to 17% (quick-commerce breakeven slips; AI Labs losses persist; EU DSA follow-on penalties and compliance cost weigh on AIDC). Owner FCF stays negative through FY2030. The 12x FCF cap binds marginally (Gordon at 10%/2% would be 12.75x). Terminal PV exceeds EV (terminal_pct 115%) because the explicit years are net cash-consuming -- the bear's operating business is worth its FY2032+ flows less the FY2027-30 burn.

base.growth_rationale: FY2027 +9% matches the Q1 FY2027 print (+9% YoY, clean of the Sun Art/Intime disposals that held FY2026 to +3% reported / +11% like-for-like). Cloud (16% of revenue, +45%) and quick commerce (+45%) each add ~3-4pp of group growth while core CMR is ~flat (-7% reported, ~+1% ex the subsidy contra-revenue change). Decelerates to 4% by FY2036 as cloud growth normalises; 10-yr CAGR 6.9%.
base.margin_rationale: Adjusted EBITDA (pre-SBC) margin was 20.3% FY2023-25 and 11.1% in the FY2026 trough. Q1 FY2027 adjusted EBITA margin 10.2% (~14% on an EBITDA basis) with AI Labs losing RMB13.9bn in the quarter. FY2027 13.5% (below the Q1 run-rate to allow for AI Labs/Qwen inference losses still widening), recovering as quick commerce reaches unit-economics breakeven (guided end-FY2027) and cloud scales at a 12%-and-rising EBITA margin; matures at 22%, slightly above FY2023-25 because the loss-making AIDC/local-services drag shrinks and cloud mix rises.
base.capex_rationale: Q1 FY2027 capex RMB67.7bn (+75% YoY, a new high; 25% of quarterly revenue) annualises to ~RMB250-270bn = ~22% of FY2027 revenue; the RMB380bn three-year plan is being exceeded. Intensity held at 20% in FY2028 (absolute peak FY2027-28), then normalises to 9.5% by FY2035 -- above the 5-6% pre-AI norm because cloud (~35% of revenue by FY2036 at ~25% capex intensity) is a larger share. D&A lags capex (4-5 year server lives) and peaks at 10% of revenue in FY2030-31; it shelters cash tax in the heavy years. This pushes the owner-FCF turn to FY2030 (prior build: FCF positive and growing 22% from FY2027).
base.tax_rationale: 18% cash rate on EBIT: 15% HNTE rate on the core PRC subsidiaries, 25% standard elsewhere, plus withholding on repatriation; FY2025 income tax 35.4bn on ~165bn pre-tax = 21% including investment-gain taxes. Same in all scenarios.

bull.rationale: Same RMB capex in absolute terms as base but spread over faster revenue (cloud sustains 40%+ through FY2029 on Apple Intelligence distribution and the $100bn five-year external cloud+AI target), so intensity falls faster; cloud mix lifts the mature EBITDA margin to 25%. The 15x FCF cap binds (Gordon at 10%/3.5% would be 15.9x).

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 15x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Moved from the prior 25/50/25 to 30/50/20. Bear up 5pp: since July the evidence has gone the bear's way on three independent fronts -- capex accelerated (+75% YoY) rather than plateaued, a new regulatory venue opened (largest-ever DSA fine, remediation deadline lapsed with outcome unknown, open-ended 6%-of-turnover exposure), and consumer-AI losses quadrupled with buybacks cut 80% to fund it -- while the DoD litigation is unresolved. Bull down 5pp: the bull needs several independent things to go right at once (sustained 40%+ cloud growth, capex intensity falling from FY2029, quick-commerce breakeven on schedule, no further EU penalties, a DoD win). Base 50%: the single most likely path is still gradual normalisation from FY2030, which is what the Q1 FY2027 cloud margin inflection and the continued subsidy de-escalation support.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
